CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS  dm_otc_n.bi_otc_cross_sale( 
	 company_name string COMMENT '公司名称' , company_id string COMMENT '公司ID' , coop_dept string COMMENT '协同部门' , summary string COMMENT '简述' , cross_sale_amount string COMMENT '交叉发放金额' ) COMMENT 'OTC部门交叉销售表' PARTITIONED BY ( busi_date string COMMENT '业务日期' ) STORED AS ORC;

SELECT company_name,
	company_id,
	coop_dept,
	summary,
	cross_sale_amount,
	busi_date FROM (
	 /*====================================================================================
 * [交叉销售表] dm_otc_n.bi_otc_cross_sale
 *------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 数据源    : DM_OTC_N.OTC_REV_DAILY_RPT (主表)
 *            T98_OTC_DERI_UNDRL_INCOME_RWD_SUM (交叉销售收入奖励汇总)
 * 逻辑说明 : 以主表公司范围为基准，每家公司固定输出4行（托管/研究服务/财富代销/商机转介）
 *===================================================================================*/

SELECT
    t_base.company_name                                -- 公司名称
    ,t_base.company_id                                 -- 公司ID
    ,d.coop_dept                                       -- 协同部门
    ,case d.coop_dept
        when '托管'     then null
        when '财富代销' then t_cfmx.summary
        when '研究服务' then if(t_tg_yjfw.company_name is not null, '有研究服务关系', '无研究服务关系')
        when '商机转介' then t_sjjz.summary
     end as summary                                              -- 简述
    ,case d.coop_dept
        when '托管'     then t_tg_yjfw.cross_sale_amount
        when '财富代销' then t_cfmx.cross_sale_amount
        when '研究服务' then t_tg_yjfw.cross_sale_amount
        when '商机转介' then t_sjjz.cross_sale_amount
     end    as cross_sale_amount -- 交叉发放金额

    ,'${yyyy-MM-dd}' as busi_date                      -- 业务日期
from (
    -- ============================================================
    -- 主表：公司范围（去重，作为驱动行）
    -- ============================================================
    select distinct
        Cutp_Pty_Full_Name as company_name
        ,USCC as company_id
    from DM_OTC_N.OTC_REV_DAILY_RPT
    where busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
      and grp_id in ('01','02','03')
      and Accrued_Date between '${yyyy,-1y}-01-01' and '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
) t_base
-- 每家公司展开4个协同部门（笛卡尔积）
cross join (
    select '托管' as coop_dept union all
    select '财富代销' union all
    select '研究服务' union all
    select '商机转介'
) d

-- =====================================================================
-- Part1+2: 托管 & 研究服务
-- Bel_Inr_Org_Name=资产托管部 → 托管
-- Bel_Inr_Org_Name=发展研究中心 → 研究服务
-- =====================================================================
left join (
    SELECT
        Pty_Cutp_Name as company_name
        ,if(Bel_Inr_Org_Name='资产托管部', '托管', '研究服务') as coop_dept               -- 区分托管/研究服务
        ,sum(Dev_Dept_Rwd) as cross_sale_amount       -- 交叉销售金额
    from pdata_n.T98_OTC_DERI_UNDRL_INCOME_RWD_SUM
    where busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
      and src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_OIS.G_CROSS_INCOME_REWARD'
      and Sett_Time between '${yyyy,-1y}01' and concat('${yyyy}0', quarter('${yyyy-MM-dd}'))
      and Bel_Inr_Org_Name in ('资产托管部', '发展研究中心')
    group by Pty_Cutp_Name, Bel_Inr_Org_Name
) t_tg_yjfw 
  on t_base.company_name = t_tg_yjfw.company_name
  and d.coop_dept = t_tg_yjfw.coop_dept

-- =====================================================================
-- Part3: 财富代销（通过代签产品index_val判断）
-- Bel_Inr_Org_Name=财富管理与经纪业务总部 → 交叉销售金额归属财富代销
-- =====================================================================
left join (
    SELECT 
        r.Cutp_Pty_Full_Name as company_name
        ,r.USCC as company_id
        ,case 
            when sum(case when coalesce(wei.index_val, 0) > 0 then 1 else 0 end) > 0 
             then '有财富代销'
             else '无财富代销'
         end as summary                                -- 有/无财富代销
        ,t_rwd.cross_sale_amount                      -- 交叉销售金额（已预聚合）
    from (
        select distinct Agt_Id, Cutp_Pty_Full_Name, USCC,Sign_Prd_Name
        from DM_OTC_N.OTC_REV_DAILY_RPT
        where busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
          and grp_id in ('01','02','03')
          and Accrued_Date between '${yyyy,-1y}-01-01' and '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
    ) r
    left join (
        -- 财富代销
        select
            prd.signature_name
            ,sum(cast(idx.index_val as double)) as index_val
        from dm_index_n.index_grp2_TnrAmtProp_Season idx 
        JOIN (
            SELECT grp_id, split(grp_val,'\\\.')[2] as prod_code
            FROM dm_index_n.grp_def WHERE grp_type_code IN ('NEWS_SECU')
        ) grp1 on idx.grp_id1 = grp1.grp_id
        JOIN (SELECT * FROM dm_index_n.grp_def WHERE grp_type_code IN ('BUSINESSOFFICE')) grp2
        on idx.grp_id2 = grp2.grp_id
        join(
            select distinct prod_code, signature_name
            from ODATA_N_OIS.O_OTC_DERIVATIVE_COUNTERPARTY
            where Busi_Date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
        ) prd on grp1.prod_code = prd.prod_code
        where idx.busi_quat between '${yyyy,-1y}Q1' and concat('${yyyy}Q', quarter('${yyyy-MM-dd}'))
          and idx.tag_id = 'tag999999999'
        group by prd.signature_name
    ) wei
    on r.Sign_Prd_Name = wei.signature_name               -- 用主表代签产品名直接关联
    left join (
        -- 先按公司汇总交叉销售金额
        SELECT
            Pty_Cutp_Name
            ,sum(Dev_Dept_Rwd) as cross_sale_amount
        from pdata_n.T98_OTC_DERI_UNDRL_INCOME_RWD_SUM
        where busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
          and src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_OIS.G_CROSS_INCOME_REWARD'
          and Sett_Time between '${yyyy,-1y}01' and concat('${yyyy}0', quarter('${yyyy-MM-dd}'))
          and Bel_Inr_Org_Name = '财富管理与经纪业务总部'
        group by Pty_Cutp_Name
    ) t_rwd on r.Cutp_Pty_Full_Name = t_rwd.Pty_Cutp_Name
    group by r.Cutp_Pty_Full_Name, r.USCC, t_rwd.cross_sale_amount
) t_cfmx on t_base.company_id = t_cfmx.company_id

-- =====================================================================
-- Part4: 商机转介（引入部门）
-- =====================================================================
left join (
    SELECT
        t.Pty_Cutp_Name as company_name
        ,concat_ws('；', collect_set(t.Bel_Inr_Org_Name)) as summary   -- 引入部门(多值；分隔)
        ,sum(t.Dev_Dept_Rwd) as cross_sale_amount                       -- 交叉销售金额
    from pdata_n.T98_OTC_DERI_UNDRL_INCOME_RWD_SUM t
    where t.busi_date = '${yyyy-MM-dd}'
      and t.src_tbl = 'ODATA_N_OIS.G_CROSS_INCOME_REWARD'
      and t.Sett_Time between '${yyyy, -1y}01' and concat('${yyyy}0', quarter('${yyyy-MM-dd}'))
      and t.Bel_Inr_Org_Name != '股权衍生品业务部'
    group by t.Pty_Cutp_Name
) t_sjjz on t_base.company_name = t_sjjz.company_name 
	) castTable
